## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)
library(gifski)
```

## Q1

```{r}
adult <- read_csv("adult_census_missing.csv")

ggplot(adult, aes(x = age, y = hours.per.week)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Age vs Hours Worked: {closest_state}",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Hours Worked per Week",
    caption = "Adult Census Income"
  ) +
  transition_states(income)
```

## Q2

```{r}
ggplot(adult, aes(x = education)) +
  geom_bar() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Education Levels: {closest_state}",
    x = "Education",
    y = "Count",
    caption = "Adult Census Income"
  ) +
  transition_states(income)
```

## Q3

```{r}
who <- read_csv("https://bryantstats.github.io/math421/data/WHO-COVID-19-global-data.csv")

who2 <- who %>%
  mutate(month = format(as.Date(Date_reported), "%Y-%m")) %>%
  filter(substr(month, 1, 4) == "2021") %>%
  group_by(month, Country) %>%
  summarise(deaths = sum(New_deaths, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  slice_max(deaths, n = 10)

ggplot(who2, aes(x = reorder(Country, deaths), y = deaths, fill = Country)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "COVID Deaths: {closest_state}",
       x = "Country", y = "Deaths") +
  transition_states(month)
```


## Q4

```{r}
df <- read_csv("https://bryantstats.github.io/math421/data/all-states-history.csv")

df2 <- df %>%
  mutate(month = format(date, "%Y-%m")) %>%
  group_by(month, state) %>%
  summarise(deaths = sum(deathIncrease, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  slice_max(deaths, n = 10)

ggplot(df2, aes(x = reorder(state, deaths), y = deaths, fill = state)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "COVID Deaths by State: {closest_state}",
       x = "State", y = "Deaths") +
  transition_states(month)
```
